findings.scientific_impact: Missing current_season_all_star predicate falsely labels 49 nonstar report-only rows, including 12 at-risk onsets (9 pre, 3 post). Full-control national estimate changes 2.674231729 -> 3.063532484 pp; linear-only 1.282369453 -> 1.661214200 pp, N unchanged.
findings.reproducibility_impact: Legacy hashes reproduce this semantic error; numerical compatibility cannot certify the declared star rule.
findings.recommended_action: Block scientific freeze. Add the missing current-season selection predicate in a separately versioned scientific correction; execute the actual October builder with verified retained inputs and refresh all affected star-stratified results. Keep frozen artifacts/targets intact.

findings.scientific_impact: Prior-ten-row workload can count the second record of the current physical game and depend on tie order. No same-game played minutes were observed leaking: all duplicate rows have zero minutes.
findings.reproducibility_impact: Player-team-game keys remain valid; sorting tied player/game records changes some calculated controls.
findings.recommended_action: Clarify whether window counts physical games or roster rows; use a simultaneous/unique-player-game history for a new scientific version, or show the tiny affected-control sensitivity. Do not rewrite the frozen panel.

findings.scientific_impact: Full-control design has rank 21 for 22 columns because dist_to_65 = 65 - prior_games. Dropping the redundant column preserves fitted values to <1e-15 and primary coefficients to numerical precision; only a tiny finite-sample covariance correction changes.
findings.reproducibility_impact: OLS pseudoinverse yields reproducible focal estimates but the two individual slopes are not separately identified.
findings.recommended_action: Document redundancy; in a new estimator version drop one redundant column and record the covariance convention. No change to frozen executables is required.

findings.scientific_impact: PPP, award eligibility and Cup regime overlap; TV/star status and risk-set membership are nonrandom. Differential star-TV trends, spillovers and roster composition are unverified. Null pretrend/placebo tests do not prove identification.
findings.reproducibility_impact: Does not prevent conditional numerical reproduction.
findings.recommended_action: Retain observational/regime-association interpretation; no isolated PPP causal claim or equivalence inference from nonsignificance. No new model campaign is required.

findings.scientific_impact: At-risk rule reconstructs exactly, but 798 risk rows follow a previous roster game without a usable injury report. Previous availability may rely on boxscore information. Coach-decision DNPs are not coded absent; onset is not a medically confirmed injury or a direct measure of illicit rest.
findings.reproducibility_impact: An explicitly defined observed-roster/report-availability estimand is reproducible, not a full census of all contracted-player health states.
findings.recommended_action: Describe both current-report requirement and prior boxscore-based status, trade/reentry censoring, coach DNP treatment, and roster selection. Quantify missingness by season; do not equate onsets with verified discretionary rest.

findings.scientific_impact: Player/game clustering is reasonable for the stated dependence structure but not all team/time shocks. Original full national p=.042634, player/date p=.047485, player/team-season p=.033487; linear remains nonsignificant. No preregistration/global multiplicity correction is established.
findings.reproducibility_impact: Point estimates, N, SE and CIs independently reproduce; alternative covariance checks are exploratory, not a replacement specification.
findings.recommended_action: Report nominal p-values, all TV definitions, uncertainty and within-family BH scope; do not infer a significant difference between the two estimates merely from different significance labels.

findings.scientific_impact: No new evidence of wrong scientific values arises from the missing combined JSON run, apart from SCI-001 independently found.
findings.reproducibility_impact: Seven-stage PDF execution is supported by receipts and output bytes; authentic combined nine-stage PDF+JSON execution is not established.
findings.recommended_action: Keep Release B unverified. Supply original cache and run the existing combination when the expanded scope is pursued; do not require this provenance work to repair SCI-001.

findings.scientific_impact: Covariates, crosswalk/award/Cup/TV enrichments, reviewed taxonomy and timing observations remain partly inherited. Computational leaves must not be mislabeled human decisions.
findings.reproducibility_impact: Conditional exact replay is supported; unrestricted primary-source reconstruction and acquisition authenticity are not.
findings.recommended_action: Release with a source/input ledger and rights/access route. Reconnect only a computational leaf whose scientific benefit justifies the cost; no blanket reconstruction campaign.

findings.scientific_impact: Controlled experiment found no change to tested scientific panels/models. No contradictory evidence emerged in this audit.
findings.reproducibility_impact: Original S4 join and exact historical team artifact remain unresolved.
findings.recommended_action: Preserve separate historical-artifact verdict. Do not reopen this exception because of the unrelated SCI-001 star defect.

findings.scientific_impact: No implication that public athlete facts are automatically confidential; the issue is redistribution basis, scope and research commitments. Existing public bulk records expose more than the four diagnostics.
findings.reproducibility_impact: No new player records were committed in this audit. Current terms do not establish the applicable historical permissions or a blanket redistribution license.
findings.recommended_action: Owner must document publication basis for bulk data and PRIVATE-named members. Prefer aggregate diagnostics where identifiers add no needed verification. Do not delete/redact/rewrite history without explicit approval.

findings.scientific_impact: The separate supplied human files genuinely yield 260/300 agreement and kappa .834881321. Human identities/blinding are owner-attested; medical truth and held-out validation are not established. Older Claude 300/300 provenance describes a different exercise.
